changes.effect: Move chunking/pruning helpers and ModelOutput to their current Transformers modules.
Use Python importlib.metadata, relocated ModelOutput/logging, and installed-module availability check.
Import PretrainedConfig and logging from their documented current locations.
Generate paired artificial histories and 1024-dimensional concept input; preserve projection; set CPU threads and UTF-8 logs; use original model loss for two updates.

original_loss_issue_retained.description: Original get_loss averages a head over all samples before treatment masking.

concept_initialization_behavior_retained.interpretation: Original constructor post_init applies BERT embedding initialization, including the frozen concept lookup table. This package preserves this behavior and starts from random weights.
